summary: Three churches (Christ the King, Epiphany, Pope John XXIII). Masses are in the daily calendar of all five bulletins and match the site; Epiphany weekday Masses are in its chapel on the parish grounds. Confession and Adoration use the page 1 boxes, with monthly ones cited from older bulletins (R12). Open: Monday Adoration end time (4:00 or 4:30), the Monday 4:30 Novena (the site calls it a Mass), and whether Nov 7 First Saturday adoration is monthly.
